rationale: The frozen decoder keeps one argmax class although all eight independent logits are exposed. The raw class oracle and large bicycle class-agnostic recall gap motivate testing this information without retraining.
checkpoint: frozen Dfull selected; require exact existing aligned receipt SHA
population: all 23958 existing public selection frames, all raw annotations
proposals: one hypothesis per existing geometry and class, usually 50 times 8 = 400; reject above 500; no new geometry
score: preserve historical argmax confidence exactly; other classes use stable float64 sigmoid of saved float32 logits
ordering: original proposal order then frozen taxonomy order
controls: frozen argmax baseline with sigmoid confidence
checks: all child geometries and velocities unchanged
matching-record resume preserves global score-tie ordering
promotion_gate: At least +0.005 raw macro mAP versus the ranked incumbent, inspect every per-class drop above 0.01, and validate an executable label-free inference producer before packaging. A smaller gain over the unranked baseline is mechanism evidence only.
limitation: No improvement in class-agnostic geometric coverage is possible. Additional wrong-class hypotheses may increase false positives. Selection is already exposed; a gain is not a claim of SOTA or eight-class excellence.
